chapter_title_en: Rising Winds Overseas – Laying a Bait and an Ambush
chapter_seo_title: RMJI Chapter 567: Han Li's Deal to Assassinate a Sect Elder
chapter_meta_description: Han Li and Madam Fan set a trap for a treacherous elder, but a Nascent Soul cultivator's arrival complicates their plan. A classic lesson in Mortal Stream negotiation and cold-blooded strategy.
og_title: The Art of the Mortal Stream Ambush in RMJI Ch. 567
og_description: Han Li’s plan to eliminate a rival runs into a major obstacle: a Nascent Soul cultivator. Time for a tactical recalculation.
twitter_description: When a Nascent Soul cultivator crashes your assassination party, you don't fight him. You make a better deal. #xianxia

lore_anchors.definition: The top cultivator of the Biyun Sect, an early Nascent Soul cultivator allied with Yun Tianxiao.
A rare and valuable cultivation material used as bait in Madam Fan's trap.
The fourth major stage of cultivation, signifying a qualitative shift in power; cultivators at this level are continent-level powers.
A living person used as a consumable resource for a cultivator’s dual cultivation techniques; often a beautiful female cultivator offered as a tool.
